mobile.text:
Description: The penetration rate in the e-commerce market in Canada was modeled to amount to 69.24 percent in 2024. Following a continuous upward trend, the penetration rate has risen by 34.3 percentage points since 2017. Between 2024 and 2029, the
penetration rate will rise by 16.52 percentage points, continuing its consistent upward trajectory. Read more
Note(s): Canada; 2017 to 2029
Source(s): Statista; Statista Market Insights
